title: Input Pre-Screen
description: A static input pre-screen filter that mitigates LLM01 (Prompt Injection) from the OWASP LLM Top 10.
Scans incoming questions and context against heuristic regex rules detecting instruction overrides,
delimiter injection, encoding evasion, and jailbreak patterns. Wraps untrusted content in cryptographic
nonce fences so downstream LLM nodes treat it strictly as data.</br>
Policy modes: block (reject injections), warn (log and continue), log (silent).
All checks are pure stdlib — no external dependencies, no model calls, no network latency.

strict.title: Strict: Block injections, enable nonce fencing

moderate.title: Moderate: Warn on injections, enable nonce fencing

block_ignore_instructions.title: Block instruction overrides
block_ignore_instructions.description: Scan input for prompt injection heuristics (instruction overrides, jailbreaks, delimiter injection)

enable_nonce_fencing.title: Enable nonce fencing
enable_nonce_fencing.description: Wrap untrusted content in cryptographic nonce fences for downstream LLM isolation

nonce_length.title: Nonce length (bytes)
nonce_length.description: Length of the cryptographic nonce in bytes (min 16, max 128)

policy_mode.title: Policy mode
policy_mode.description: How to handle detected injections: block (reject), warn (log + continue), log (silent)

custom_rules.title: Custom rules
custom_rules.description: Additional regex heuristic rules (each: id, pattern, category, severity, description)

max_input_length.title: Max input length (chars)
max_input_length.description: Maximum character count for input text (0 = no limit)
